tools.name: find_station
tools.description: Find railway stations by name in Poland – every passenger station, Polish letters optional. Returns the station name and the matching trainradar24.eu page.

tools.name: station_departures
tools.description: Live departure or arrival board for any passenger railway station in Poland, small stops included: time, carrier, train number, destination or origin, platform, live delay, cancellation and replacement buses. Trains that already left are hidden.

tools.name: poland_delays_now
tools.description: Snapshot of current train delays and cancellations across Poland: totals, the most delayed trains and cancelled trains. Refreshed several times a day.

tools.name: poland_disruptions
tools.description: Official PKP PLK disruption notices in Poland (closed sections, replacement buses, timetable changes), filtered by date and optionally by station or place name.

tools.name: poland_punctuality
tools.description: Trainradar24's own 30-day punctuality ranking of Polish rail carriers and the least punctual routes, computed from official PKP PLK traffic data. On time = arrived within 5 minutes and not cancelled.

tools.name: poland_train_punctuality
tools.description: How often a named long-distance train in Poland (e.g. "Flisak", "Kaszub", "Podhalanin" or its number, e.g. "54102") arrived on time over the last 30 days: on-time share, typical delay, cancellations. Covers about 30 named PKP Intercity trains; for other trains use poland_route_punctuality.

tools.name: poland_route_punctuality
tools.description: How punctual direct trains between two Polish cities were over the last 30 days (e.g. Gdańsk – Kraków, Warszawa – Zakopane): on-time share, typical delay, cancellations, trains per day.
